title: Queued-resume and Waves launch TUI follow-ups (split from S307)
lead: The Waves launch shows a missing check command before the spec check, the launch confirm scrolls, and a run whose resume waits for a slot shows its own wait time, a cue, x stop at 80x24 and a refusal that fits 80 columns.
findings_note: S258 and S274 reviews and gates, 2026-11-07; re-anchored 2026-11-18; split from S307 by the owner on 2026-11-18.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
TUI follow-ups from the reviewers, UI passes and gates of S258 and S274 (2026-11-07), split out of S307 on 2026-11-18 (owner). Each was re-anchored against main on 2026-11-18. The slice touches `internal/tui` and its golden views, so it gets a full UI pass (rule u10).

- T1. The Waves launch goes from `confirmWave` to the spec check and then the confirm (`internal/tui/waves.go:305-313`) without the `check: none` line and the adj 191 (`launch.no-check-command`) refusal that the launch confirm shows before y (`internal/tui/launch.go:555-570`). The daemon error comes afterwards and suggests `--allow-no-check`, which the TUI cannot pass.
- T2. The launch confirm clips the warnings and the note below the roles at 80x24 behind "+N more lines" (`window`, `internal/tui/view.go:1093-1108`), and the confirm takes every key, so they cannot be scrolled to.
- T3. The refusal for t or an answer on a run whose resume waits, "resume already waits for a slot; ork stop RUN cancels it" (`internal/tui/model.go:1829-1832`), wraps with one word alone on its second line at 80 columns with a real run id.
- T4. The Running heard cell reads `wait 20m` from when the wait began (`heardCell`, `internal/tui/relayboard.go:154-161`), not from when the resume was queued; the record has `Resume.At` (`internal/daemon/runs.go:2434`) but `EngineRun` carries only `ResumeWaiting` and `WaitStartedAt` (`internal/daemon/runs.go:2877`).
- T5. At 80x24 the pane hint of a run whose resume waits loses `x stop`, the only action left for it (drop order in `internal/tui/keys.go:213-228`).
- T6. An unselected row of a run whose resume waits has no cue beside `wait 20m`: `resumeWaiting` is set on the row (`internal/tui/overview.go:67`, `internal/tui/overview.go:443`) but no row renderer reads it.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Each item was re-anchored on 2026-11-18. At step 1, a test that is already green means a later slice fixed that item: drop the test and the item and say so in the report.

TUI (golden views at 80x24, mono and colour, where a view is checked):

- `TestWavesLaunchShowsTheNoCheckRefusalBeforeTheSpecCheck` in `internal/tui/waves_test.go`: a ticked item whose plan has no check command; pressing l shows `check: none`, the `refused:` line and `fix: ork projects set ...`, and starts no spec check. Red today: the spec check starts (T1).
- `TestLaunchConfirmScrollsToClippedWarnings` in `internal/tui/launch_test.go`: a plan with 8 warnings at 80x24; the down key in the confirm moves the window so the last warning shows, and y still starts. Red today: the confirm takes every key and the warnings stay clipped (T2).
- `TestResumeWaitingRefusalFitsEightyColumns` in `internal/tui/pane_test.go`: t on a run `ork-20261118-130321-4cea` whose resume waits; the status line at 80 columns has no line holding a single word. Red today (T3).
- `TestHeardCellOfAQueuedResumeCountsFromTheResume` in `internal/tui/resumewait_test.go`: a run paused 50 min ago whose resume was queued 5 min ago shows `wait 5m`. Red today: `wait 50m` (T4).
- `TestQueuedResumePaneHintKeepsXStopAt80x24` in `internal/tui/pane_test.go`: the pane hint of such a run at 80x24 contains `x stop`. Red today (T5).
- `TestQueuedResumeRowHasACue` in `internal/tui/resumewait_test.go`: the unselected row of such a run shows `resume queued` beside its wait cell. Red today: no cue (T6).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason. Drop any item whose test is already green and say so in the report.
2.T1-T6: the Waves launch checks the plan's check command before the spec check and shows the launch confirm's lines; the launch confirm scrolls with the up and down keys; the t refusal is shortened to fit 80 columns (wording from the UI pass); `EngineRun` gains the resume's queue time and the heard cell uses it; `x stop` outlasts the other keys on a queued-resume pane; the row shows `resume queued`. Rewrite the golden views with `go test ./internal/tui -update` and review the diff.
3. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md` (T1-T6). Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S449 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- The Waves launch shows a missing check command before the spec check; the launch confirm can be scrolled; a queued resume shows its own wait time, a cue, x stop at 80x24, and a refusal that fits 80 columns.
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner looks at the Waves launch with no check command and a queued-resume run in the TUI at 80x24.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/tui -run 'TestWavesLaunchShowsTheNoCheckRefusalBeforeTheSpecCheck|TestLaunchConfirmScrollsToClippedWarnings|TestResumeWaitingRefusalFitsEightyColumns|TestHeardCellOfAQueuedResumeCountsFromTheResume|TestQueuedResumePaneHintKeepsXStopAt80x24|TestQueuedResumeRowHasACue' -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
